T: We are Venom. We are hungry.
D: A disgraced reporter bonds with an alien symbiote that has a big appetite.
P: Serve the mains when Eddie climbs into the lobster tank at the restaurant.
S: Frozen potato gems baked at 220C for 20 minutes until crunchy, with a chilli and garlic mayo.
the black goo of the symbiote
Chicken pieces fried crisp, tossed in a sticky soy and honey glaze, coated in black sesame seeds.
M: Lobster tank garlic butter lobster tails
Eddie jumping into the restaurant's lobster tank

Lobster tails split, brushed with garlic and herb butter, grilled 6 minutes, with fries and lemon. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and fry twice until crisp. Split 4 lobster tails, brush with butter mixed with crushed garlic and parsley, and grill for 6 minutes until just cooked. Serve with the fries and lemon wedges. Tater tots optional.
Eddie and Venom starving at all hours

Double beef patties with melted cheddar, crisp bacon and pickles in toasted buns, with a pile of crunchy double-cooked fries. Cut 1kg potatoes into fries and cook at 140C for 6 minutes, then drain. Fry 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Shape 800g beef mince into 8 thin patties, season and grill 2 minutes a side, adding cheddar slices for the last minute. Fry the chips again at 190C for 3 minutes and salt. Toast 4 buns and stack 2 patties each with bacon, pickles, onion, mustard and tomato sauce.
W: Silky Hong Kong mango pudding set in glasses, with a pour of evaporated milk over the top and fresh mango cubes. Dissolve 3 tsp gelatine in 100ml hot water. Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with 80g caster sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside. Stir in the gelatine, then 200ml evaporated milk and 100ml cream. Pour into 4 glasses and chill for at least 4 hours until set. Just before serving, pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.
K: Strong black tea sweetened with condensed milk, chilled and poured over ice with a splash of milk.

s.how: Toss 600g chicken thigh pieces in cornflour and fry until crisp. Warm 3 tbsp soy sauce with 3 tbsp honey until bubbling and toss the chicken through. Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark. Serve on toothpicks.

Bake 1kg frozen potato gems at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until crunchy. Mix 150g mayonnaise with 2 tbsp sriracha and 1 crushed garlic clove. Serve the gems in a big bowl with the mayo for dunking.
